blocks.body:
Good morning, **Sam**.
Your 📅 **Dinner with Alex** is today at **1:08 PM**.

rows.title: Start with a daily brief
rows.subtitle: Your calendar and important email, on one page.

action.label: Get brief
action.prompt: Prepare my daily brief now. Use today's calendar and relevant email when connected, synthesize what needs me, and make the answer visual and actionable.

cards.title: Explain how a heat pump works
cards.prompt: Explain how a heat pump works, step by step, with what it costs to run compared with a furnace.

cards.title: Compare running shoes for flat feet
cards.prompt: Compare a few well-reviewed running shoes for flat feet by support, cushioning, fit and price.

cards.title: Plan a picnic for Saturday afternoon
cards.prompt: Plan a picnic for Saturday afternoon near me with a good spot, the weather, and what to pack.

cards.title: Cook a weeknight curry in 30 minutes
cards.prompt: Give me a weeknight curry I can cook in 30 minutes with exact ingredients and clear steps.

cards.title: Find a quiet park for a long walk
cards.prompt: Find a few quiet parks near me for a long walk and show them on a map with what makes each one nice.
